map.通气比值分析是做什么的？: What does Ventilatory Equivalent Analyzer do?
map.如何使用通气比值分析？: How do I use Ventilatory Equivalent Analyzer?
map.通气比值分析适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Ventilatory Equivalent Analyzer best for?
map.输入逐级递增负荷下的通气量(VE)与摄氧量(VO2)，计算 VE/VO2 通气当: Enter ventilation (VE) and oxygen uptake (VO2) at graded incremental loads to compute the VE/VO2 ventilatory equivalent, auto-detect the ventilatory threshold (VT) and assess the aerobic-to-anaerobic transition.
map.通气当量 EQ = VE / VO₂（或 VE / VCO₂）；VT 为 EQ: Ventilatory equivalent EQ = VE / VO₂ (or VE / VCO₂); VT is the nonlinear breakpoint of EQ
map.逐级递增负荷下通气量 VE 与摄氧量 VO₂ 之比即通气当量；VE/VO₂ 出现: At graded incremental loads, the ratio of ventilation VE to oxygen uptake VO₂ is the ventilatory equivalent; the breakpoint where VE/VO₂ rises steeply and nonlinearly is the ventilatory threshold (VT), corresponding to the aerobic-to-anaerobic transition intensity.
map.VE / VO2 数据序列（每行一组，格式：VE,VO2，单位 L/min）: VE / VO2 data series (one pair per line, format: VE,VO2, in L/min)
map.💡 VE/VO2 = VE ÷ VO2，安静时约 20~25；运动中先下降后回升: 💡 VE/VO2 = VE ÷ VO2, about 20-25 at rest; during exercise it falls then rises again, and the breakpoint where it turns back up is the ventilatory threshold (VT), near the anaerobic threshold. The range where VE/VO2 rises markedly while VE/VCO2 has not yet risen is the effective aerobic-training range.
map.数据应按运动强度从低到高依次排列（递增负荷测试）: Data should be ordered from low to high exercise intensity (an incremental-load test)
map.每行格式为「VE,VO2」，英文逗号分隔，至少需要 4 组数据: Each line is in the format "VE,VO2", comma-separated, with at least 4 data pairs required
map.VO2 单位为 L/min（升/分钟），若输入 ml/min 请自行换算: VO2 is in L/min (liters per minute); convert first if your input is in ml/min
map.通气阈判定基于 VE/VO2 系统性上升的拐点（v-slope 法简化版）: VT detection is based on the breakpoint where VE/VO2 rises systematically (a simplified v-slope method)
map.本工具为纯前端分析，结果供训练参考，不替代医学诊断: This tool analyzes entirely in the browser; results are for training reference and do not replace medical diagnosis
map.渐增负荷测试中观察通气当量拐点，辅助定位通气阈（VT）对应的强度。: In an incremental-load test, watch the ventilatory-equivalent breakpoint to help locate the intensity at the ventilatory threshold (VT).
map.通气当量=VE/VO2；升高拐点提示代谢性酸中毒（无氧阈附近）。: Ventilatory equivalent = VE/VO2; a rise breakpoint signals metabolic acidosis (near the anaerobic threshold).
map.VE/VO2 与 VE/VCO2 哪个定阈更准？: Which is more accurate for threshold detection, VE/VO2 or VE/VCO2?
map.VE/VCO2 通常先在 VT 处下降后回升，拐点更清晰；VE/VO2 持续上升: VE/VCO2 usually falls and then rises at VT with a clearer breakpoint, while VE/VO2 keeps rising and is often used as a supporting confirmation.
map.通气比值分析工具，输入递增负荷测试中各强度的通气量(VE)与摄氧量(VO2)，计: A ventilatory equivalent analyzer: enter ventilation (VE) and oxygen uptake (VO2) at each intensity of an incremental-load test to compute the VE/VO2 ventilatory-equivalent series, automatically identify the ventilatory threshold (VT) breakpoint, and help determine the aerobic-to-anaerobic transition range and effective aerobic-training intensity.
map.计算通气当量并标注通气阈拐点: Computes ventilatory equivalents and marks the VT breakpoint
map.量化 VE/VO2 回升幅度判定可靠性: Quantifies the VE/VO2 rebound to judge reliability
map.数据表格展示各级负荷比值: Table showing the ratio at each load level
